description.value:
Trigger Your Ward takes damage

The instant your Ward is hurt, you answer: make an immediate melee or ranged Strike against whoever dealt the damage, with no MAP increase from this Strike specifically. On a hit, the target takes a status penalty equal to 2 to its next saving throw against an effect you create before the end of your next turn — the debt comes due whether they meant to incur it or not.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Strike-with-no-MAP-bump portion needs no rule element (a fixed rules-text exception, same as Reactive Strike's own 'doesn't count toward your MAP' clause shipping unencoded, confirmed via pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/class/shared/reactive-strike.json). But the 'target takes a penalty to its own next saving throw' clause is not buildable: No rule element can set a modifier, apply a condition, or read a value on/from a different creature's own roll or resource from the card holder's own item -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. (rule elements set modifiers only on the actor that owns the item, never a different creature's future roll.)
